title: Accessibility + plain-language authoring checklist
context: From-zero learners include people new to programming and people using assistive technology. This task defines the accessibility and plain-language checklist every lesson must pass, so CI (ci-007) and reviewers can enforce it.
objective: Author an accessibility + plain-language authoring checklist (alt text, colour-contrast, reading level, structure/headings, code-block accessibility) that every lesson must satisfy and CI can check.
acceptanceCriteria: Defines concrete, checkable accessibility requirements (alt text on figures, colour-contrast, semantic headings/structure, keyboard/screen-reader-friendly code blocks).
Defines plain-language requirements (reading-level target, jargon-on-first-use definitions, glossary linkage).
Items are machine-checkable where feasible so ci-007 can enforce them.
Reviewed by Pedagogy; output licensed CC-BY-4.0.
resources: PLAN.md (binding cancer guardrails / Data, licensing & compliance)
